title: backlog_dispatch and backlog_begin start a worker's headless session as a job of the operations service, with the CLI's own caps
goal: With KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 the kb MCP server lists backlog_dispatch (id, model, max_turns, known, known_suite, probe, dry_run, and resume with message) and backlog_begin (ids up to four, by, trailer, dry_run, model, max_turns, max_budget_usd, known, known_suite, probe), each parsing its argv with the backlog.py parser and submitting it through ops_service.submit like the land tool; begin with more than four ids is a rejected outcome before any submit, as the CLI refuses it; a dry_run call prints the plan inline through backlog.main and starts nothing and no job; the tools pass only the caps the caller gave (the CLI's own per-kind --max-turns stays), openWorldHint is true (each starts a model session), readOnlyHint false and destructiveHint false

run: import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,importlib;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS"]="1";[os.environ.pop(k,None) for k in ("CLAUDECODE","CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION")];R=os.getcwd();d=tempfile.mkdtemp();open(d+"/ops_service.py","w").write("CALLS=[];submit=lambda verb,argv,item=None,session=None:(CALLS.append((verb,argv,item)),{\"job\":\"J-test0002\",\"verb\":verb,\"item\":item,\"state\":\"queued\"})[1]");sys.path.insert(0,d);importlib.invalidate_caches();import kb_mcp,ops_service;a=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *x:subprocess.run(["git","-C",a,*x],check=True,capture_output=True);g("init","-q");g("config","user.email","a@example.com");g("config","user.name","n");iid=subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",a,"new","story","--title","Planted","--goal","g","--touch","x/*","--check","true"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()[2];g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","plant");os.chdir(a);call=lambda n,**k:kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":n,"arguments":k}})["result"];r=call("backlog_dispatch",id=iid,max_turns=5);assert not r["isError"] and r["structuredContent"]["job"]=="J-test0002",r;assert ops_service.CALLS[-1][0]=="dispatch" and ops_service.CALLS[-1][1][:2]==["dispatch",iid] and "--max-turns" in ops_service.CALLS[-1][1],ops_service.CALLS;n=len(ops_service.CALLS);five=call("backlog_begin",ids=[iid]*5,by="orch");assert five["isError"] and len(ops_service.CALLS)==n,"more than four ids submitted";assert not call("backlog_begin",ids=[iid],by="orch")["isError"] and ops_service.CALLS[-1][0]=="begin",ops_service.CALLS;m=len(ops_service.CALLS);call("backlog_begin",ids=[iid],by="orch",dry_run=True);assert len(ops_service.CALLS)==m,"a dry run submitted a job"

gates.question: Serve backlog_dispatch and backlog_begin, which each start paid headless worker sessions, as kb MCP tools, and under which cap rule?
options: Serve both with the CLI's own caps
Serve both and require max_budget_usd on every call
gates.recommendation: Serve both with the CLI's own caps
gates.reason: since the Bash route is allowed the same way and the tool adds no spend path (per-kind max-turns stays; max-budget-usd only when the caller gives it)

notes: Evidence 2026-11-08. dispatch 652 and begin 73 Bash calls in the census; backlog.py usage: dispatch runs claude -p --model sonnet --max-turns N (60 task, 100 story, 200 research) in the foreground until the worker exits, --detach starts it detached; begin claims up to four items, pushes the claims once and dispatches each detached, refusing a fifth id. In the job model the service process is the detach: the job runs dispatch in the foreground and its state is the worker's lifetime, and begin returns after its claims, push and detached dispatches. Pairing: ops_service.submit(verb 'dispatch'|'begin', argv, item=ID) as in ST-p2wmi3hq. Gate g1 (money): each call starts a paid session; the recommendation keeps the CLI's caps and adds no new spend path. A dry_run runs inline because backlog.py dispatch --dry-run and begin --dry-run write and start nothing. Interface (orchestrator, 2026-11-08): the job submit and follow interface is the ops-service half's, kj_store.submit(root, op, subject, by, options=None, store=None) -> {job, state, deduped, seq, follow} and kj_store.status(root, job, since=0, store=None) -> {job, state, exit, step, log, events, last} (ST-nwwcf3kk), followed with kbjob.py follow (ST-5h2kx2ri); the ops_service.submit name in this item's notes is replaced by it.
